{{samename|feature in [[Pokémon GO]]|GO Stamp Rally}} [[File:Pokopia Stamp Card PC Icon selected.png|thumb|250px|Stamp Card PC menu icon]] [[File:Completed Stamp Card Pokopia.png|thumb|250px|A completed Stamp Card]] The '''stamp rally''' (Japanese: '''スタンプあつめ''' ''collecting stamps'') is a feature in {{g|Pokopia}} that rewards the [[Ditto (Pokopia)|player]] for checking in daily, unlocked once the player obtains the [[Withered Wasteland|Wasteland]] [[Pokémon Center kit]]. The '''Stamp Card''' (Japanese: '''スタンプカード''' ''Stamp Card'') appears when the player boots up the [[Pokémon Center]] [[PC]] for the first time every day, and can be accessed afterwards through the Stamp Card option on the PC menu. A stamp can be added to the stamp card once a day by checking the PC, but additional stamps can be obtained through the PC in others' worlds or on [[Cloud Island]]s. If the stamp card is full, the player will be able to select an existing stamp to replace with the new one. These stamps can be exchanged for [[Currency#Pokémon Pokopia|Life Coins]] on the Friday of the stamp rally's active week, with an additional 1,500 Life Coins earned with a full stamp card. Stamps come in four rarities, each rewarding a different amount of Life Coins. {| class="roundtable c sortable" style="margin: auto; background-color:#{{pokopia color dark}}; border:3px solid #{{pokopia color}}" |- style="background-color:#{{pokopia color light}}" ! colspan=2 | Rarity !
